audit.method: Archived source PDFs under data/raw/SA/<symbol>/documents (SHA-256 re-computed and equal to data/raw/archive-index.json for all 26 archived files). Digital pages: text layer read and the printed figure located. Scanned pages (stc, Zain, Elm primary statements): pages rendered to PNG with PyMuPDF and read by eye, line by line, both columns. Findings are proven with page and line item; 'verified_correct' is claimed only where the printed page was read. Internal arithmetic (subtotals, reconciliations) used only as a secondary check, never as proof. Offline; no AWS, no Supabase, no data/raw edits.
tools_added_on_branch: docs/audits/saudi-independent/batch1-C-provenance-scan.json (machine scan of every fact vs its cited page)

findings.line_item: Information about major customers - revenues from Government entities
findings.evidence: AR2025 PDF p128 prints 'revenues of approximately %11,298 million for the year ended 31 December 2025 (2024: %11,145 million) resulting from sales to Government entities' (% = glyph of the SAR sign). Engine normalisation is raw*scale (src/finengine/normalization.py:16), so the published fact is SAR 11.3 million, 1000x too small. The sibling manifest stc-2025-company-profile.json states the same fact correctly as 'approximately SAR 11.298 billion', proving the document says billions.
findings.fix: Set scale to '1000' on this fact (value unchanged). Re-publish via Codex.

findings.line_item: Subscribers at a glance - Fixed subscribers, fixed-wired broadband subscriptions (millions)
findings.evidence: Rendered AR2025 PDF p38: stacked bars Q4 24 / Q4 25 for fixed subscribers: Q4 24 = 3.9 (telephone) + 1.3 (wired broadband) + 0.5 (wireless) = 5.7; Q4 25 = 4.1 + 1.4 + 0.5 = 6.0. The published 1.3 is the Q4 2024 comparative column. FY2024 manifest (AR2024 p53 printed: wired 1.32 m, wireless 0.50 m) is consistent with 1.3 being the prior-year value.
findings.fix: Change value to 1400000 and label to 'Wired broadband subscribers 1.4 million'.

findings.evidence: Machine scan (batch1-C-provenance-scan.json) + manual confirmation: segments-notes cites p143 for revenue_by_product, remaining_performance_obligations, deferred_tax_expense (actually PDF p144); p139 for borrowings (p140); p144 for finance_cost_by_type/expected_credit_losses (p145); p148 for purchase_commitments, other_commitments, guarantees, contingencies (p149); contract_assets cites p8 which is a page of the FS PDF, not of the AR2025 PDF the manifest points to. stc-2025-fy.json 'provisions' cites p142, a page of the AR2025 PDF, but its source_url is the 106-page FS PDF (the line is on p87). KPI manifests use printed page numbers (74/75, 53, 108, 116) while others use PDF page numbers; five_g_coverage/network_sites/fiber/data_centers have no page.
findings.fix: Normalise to PDF page numbers (add printed page under metadata). Re-run scripts/audit_manifest_provenance.py until zero page_offset/wrong_page.

findings.evidence: Sum of the four 2023 quarterly revenues exceeds the FY2023 figure by 0.78% (562.8m). AR2024 p73 footnote: '*Certain comparative figures for 2023 were reclassified', and column header '2023 Consolidated Revised'. The quarterly set was taken from the Q1-2024 presentation (pre-restatement, includes the later-discontinued operations) while FY2023 is the restated continuing-operations figure. Net profit parent reconciles (13.290 vs 13.295 bn) because discontinued profit is inside the parent total. The Q1-2024 deck itself is not archived, so the quarterly values are unverified; the basis conflict is proven arithmetically + by the AR2024 footnote.
findings.fix: Archive the Q1-2024 deck; tag the 2023 quarters as 'original basis' or replace with restated quarters from later decks; never publish FY and quarters of different vintages without a basis flag.

findings.evidence: Gap -55.4m (-0.07%): Q4 implied by FY less Q1-Q3 is 19.321 bn vs published 19.266 bn. Source deck (Q1-2025 presentation) not archived, so cannot say which is right.
